source_policy: public primary code and author paper only
objective: Keep the full600 WB-PESQ3.4 target and causal realtime/full-epoch one-hour constraints

claims.claim: FullSubNet+ default source uses utterance normalization and channel attention pooling over the time axis. It is not a drop-in strictly causal model.
OnlineSpatialNet compares causal Retention/Mamba with masked attention, but its reported evaluation is8kHz, six microphones, direct-path targets and NB-PESQ.
Pinned upstream Retention is causal in the tested synthetic case and has fixed-sized recurrent state, while chunked and recurrent modes differ numerically.
The pinned upstream CausalConv1d raises TypeError for an external state dictionary in the exercised call. A persistent per-hop adapter needs repair before reuse.
Own canonical retention prototype passes4 CPU causality/state/streaming tests plus a default-sized6s forward/backward/Adam smoke.
A frequency-specific matrix memory is a plausible structural fallback when the current attention trial gives little full-data improvement. It is not yet a selected replacement.
WB-PESQ gain on the fixed600 and full-epoch CUDA/latency compliance of the retention prototype remain unknown.

decision: Continue the scheduled complete-data attention trial. Keep the new retention prototype isolated; do not deploy it or replace active model files before real CUDA/streaming/full-data evidence.
stop_reason: Both causal implementation mechanisms and benchmark-transfer limits resolved; further model selection requires the pending full-data result.
